test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence. Rehan said to Mallika, "The Somnath Temple is in Prabhas Patan in Gujarat."

options.text: Rehan told Mallika that the Somnath Temple was in Prabhas Patan in Gujarat.
Rehan told Mallika that the Somnath Temple had been in Prabhas Patan in Gujarat.
Rehan told Mallika that the Somnath Temple has been in Prabhas Patan in Gujarat.
Rehan told Mallika that the Somnath Temple is in Prabhas Patan in Gujarat.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, the tense of the verb remains unchanged if the reported speech describes a universal truth or fact.
 
• The sentence discusses the location of the Somnath Temple, which is a factual statement and does not require a change in tense.
 
• Therefore, the verb "is" remains the same in the indirect speech form.
 
• Option 4 correctly converts the direct speech to indirect speech without altering the factual content of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rehan told Mallika that the Somnath Temple is in Prabhas Patan in Gujarat."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect as it unnecessarily changes the verb tense from "is" to "was."
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect as it changes the tense to "had been," which is not appropriate for factual statements.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect as it uses "has been," which is unnecessary in this context.
 
• **Option 4:** Correct as it keeps the factual statement intact without altering the tense.
